etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Old French bracelet, diminutive form of bras (“arm”).

definitions.definition: A band or chain worn around the wrist as jewelry/jewellery or an ornament.
The strap of a wristwatch, used to secure it around the wrist.
(historical) A piece of defensive armour for the arm.[1]

quote.citation: 1903, Campbell Cowan Edgar, Greek Sculpture, page 57:
quote.text: […]  and fastened on his breast by a buckle consisting of a Gorgoneion (with wings on temples and serpent-knot below chin), a sword-belt over right shoulder, bracelets, greaves (with lions' heads at the knees) and sandals.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To surround with, or as if with, a bracelet; to ring or encompass.
